sqlGroup.select:
select code, rname
FROM sys_region where pcode is null

with recursive region_tree as ( select aa.* from sys_region aa where aa.code = #{regionCode} union all select bb.* from sys_region bb join region_tree cc on bb.pcode = cc.code ) select a.code , a.rname , a.pcode from region_tree a
select a.code , a.rname , a.pcode from sys_region a where a.type != 3
select LPAD(a.code,6,0) as codeX, a.code, a.rname , a.pcode from sys_region a where a.type != 3
